calculations.name: Recent | Prior  Mth | Prior Yr
calculations.formula:
IF [Order Date] >= DATEADD('day', -14, [pToday]) AND [Order Date] <= [pToday] THEN 'Recent'
ELSEIF [Order Date] >= DATEADD('day', -14, [Today Last Month]) AND [Order Date] <= DATEADD('day', 14, [Today Last Month]) THEN 'Prior Month'
ELSEIF [Order Date] >= DATEADD('day', -14, [Today Last Year]) AND [Order Date] <= DATEADD('day', 14, [Today Last Year]) THEN 'Prior Year'
ELSE NULL
END

calculations.name: PR - Recent
calculations.formula: IF MIN([Recent | Prior  Mth | Prior Yr]) = 'Recent' THEN [Profit Ratio] END

calculations.name: PR - Today
calculations.formula:
//IF MIN([Recent | Prior  Mth | Prior Yr]) = 'Recent' AND MIN([X-Axis])=0 THEN [Profit Ratio] END
{FIXED:SUM(IF [Order Date]=[pToday] THEN [Profit] END)}/{FIXED:SUM(IF [Order Date]=[pToday] THEN [Sales] END)}

calculations.name: X-Axis
calculations.formula:
CASE [Recent | Prior  Mth | Prior Yr]
WHEN 'Recent' THEN DATEDIFF('day',[pToday],[Order Date])
WHEN 'Prior Month' THEN DATEDIFF('day',[Today Last Month],[Order Date])
WHEN 'Prior Year' THEN DATEDIFF('day',[Today Last Year],[Order Date])
END

calculations.name: PR - Not Recent
calculations.formula: IF MIN([Recent | Prior  Mth | Prior Yr]) <> 'Recent' THEN [Profit Ratio] END

calculations.name: PR - Yesterday
calculations.formula:
//IF MIN([Recent | Prior  Mth | Prior Yr]) = 'Recent' AND MIN([X-Axis])=0 THEN [Profit Ratio] END
{FIXED:SUM(IF [Order Date]=DATEADD('day', -1,[pToday]) THEN [Profit] END)}/{FIXED:SUM(IF [Order Date]=DATEADD('day', -1,[pToday]) THEN [Sales] END)}
